gate.reason: The V4 room capture preserved a fail-closed result: its proposed RVA 0x2FB226 owner and RVA 0x34584D simulation hooks were armed but never hit, while one NewRoom pair was immediately followed by the only otherwise ownerless EntityList pair. Fixed-build control flow instead places the ordinary-door transaction under RVA 0x2FB51C and its nested Room::Update at RVA 0x2FE37C. V5 replaces only those two disproved slots, keeps the 32-slot u64 mask, and still requires the seven-scenario V5 matrix plus stable XInput ownership before active input.
requiredEvidence: Run the V5 passive probe and correlate InputManager sample, per-device update, concrete physical poll, and the corrected ordinary-door room-change transaction with the confirmed main-thread loop iteration in all seven required scenarios.
Retain the case04 runtime proof that the generic Win32 pump at RVA 0x65E660 executes once inside each observed top-level update, without treating that 60 Hz loop as an Authority tick.

Repeat the stable owner-chain snapshot with an XInput gamepad remaining inside the active input-device vector and join its InputDeviceBase +0x0C key to a player +0x1618 assignment; the current stable snapshot proves the keyboard owner only.
Use the passive MC_INPUT_ACTION witness to correlate actions 0..11 without observing, suppressing, or synthesizing actions 12+.

Observe coherent steady standard, alternate inline, and room-lifecycle transactions under their explicit owners; classify every active alternate owner attempt including the five run-activation outcomes, and keep conditional or lifecycle-only attempts without a nested simulation distinct from Authority mutation.

V5 must repeat the required seven-scenario matrix with the corrected 0x2FB51C owner and 0x2FE37C nested simulation, both lifecycle owner/simulation pairs, 64-bit hook-mask storage, and exact 32-slot restoration.

Keyboard and Gamepad concrete vtables, the shared +0x30/+0x34/+0x38 ABI, and the current keyboard-to-player ownership join are proved. The observed XInput object left the active device vector before a stable XInput-to-player ownership join was captured, so stable XInput ownership remains unknown.
No runtime proof yet shows that every Authority mutation belongs to a gameplay tick or explicit lifecycle transaction.

constraints.rule: Offline inspection and passive observation only until this ledger gate is no longer BLOCKED_BY_EVIDENCE.
UI, pause, map, and session actions 12+ must not be observed, canonicalized, suppressed, queued, or synthesized by the T0-04 experiment.
RVA 0x500CA0 and RVA 0x510980 are OriginalOnline action/frame oracles, not proof of the offline/local-coop sample or apply boundary.

Focus loss is not a required T0-03R or T0-04 gate scenario because the fixed platform build automatically pauses on focus loss; an optional diagnostic capture cannot substitute for the independently required pause scenario.
